_meta.purpose: Handcrafted adversarial memory benchmark. Deliberately isolates the MEMORY system from raw long-context (LoCoMo's flaw): evidence sits across dated sessions, and the hard categories (knowledge_update, multi_value, temporal as-of, abstention) cannot be faked by a long-context model. Dates are fixed for deterministic temporal answers.

behavior_legend.supersede: the listed prior fact(s) must be invalidated (valid_to set); current value returned
behavior_legend.accrue: all listed values remain valid simultaneously; none invalidated
behavior_legend.abstain: no memory supports an answer; must decline, not hallucinate
behavior_legend.asof: question asks the value valid AT a past date; history must be preserved (bi-temporal)
